pull.title: test: add coverage for PSBT global fields
pull.body:
This PR adds coverage for the global PSBT field errors thrown [here](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/9bf4815b94b9eaf8807f4e569091778da6c338d5/src/psbt.h#L1515-L1556).

Checks that:
- the `PSBT_GLOBAL_VERSION` field is validated: version 3 is rejected, and version 1 too.
- a PSBT without the `PSBT_GLOBAL_VERSION` field is interpreted as a v0. A v2 PSBT is created and the field removed, so decoding fails because it is misinterpreted as a v0.
- checks that PSBTv2only global fields are rejected in a PSBTv0.
- checks that the input and output counts are required in a PSBTv2.

As an example, one of the test cases can be triggered with this diff:
```diff
diff --git a/src/psbt.h b/src/psbt.h
index 5eb5e81428..d90528e01d 100644
--- a/src/psbt.h
+++ b/src/psbt.h
@@ -94,7 +94,7 @@ inline constexpr uint8_t PSBT_SEPARATOR = 0x00;
 inline constexpr std::streamsize MAX_FILE_SIZE_PSBT{100'000'000}; // 100 MB
 
 // PSBT version number
-inline constexpr uint32_t PSBT_HIGHEST_VERSION = 2;
+inline constexpr uint32_t PSBT_HIGHEST_VERSION = 4;
 
 /** A structure for PSBT proprietary types */
 struct PSBTProprietary
```

Ideally, start with the one that should be merged first.

Concept ACK.
Left a couple of nits.
I beleive it is good to separate the test into functions, but in this case I  think we could do it with one function that covers both cases, that way we can reuse the PSBT.

```diff
--- a/test/functional/rpc_psbt.py
+++ b/test/functional/rpc_psbt.py
@@ -839,17 +839,15 @@ class PSBTTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         assert_raises_rpc_error(-8, "The PSBT version can only be 2 or 0", self.nodes[0].converttopsbt, hexstring=rawtx, psbt_version=1)
         assert_raises_rpc_error(-8, "The PSBT version can only be 2 or 0", self.nodes[0].psbtbumpfee, txid=tobump, psbt_version=1)
 
-    def test_psbt_unsupported_version_field(self):
+    def test_psbt_version_field(self):
         self.log.info("Test that the global PSBT version is supported on decode")
 
-        psbt = PSBT.from_base64(self.nodes[0].createpsbt([{"txid": "00" * 32, "vout": 0}], [{"data": "00"}]))
+        psbt = PSBT.from_base64(self.nodes[0].createpsbt([{"txid": "00" * 32, "vout": 0}], [{"data": "00"}], psbt_version=2))
         psbt.g.map[PSBT_GLOBAL_VERSION] = (3).to_bytes(4, "little")
         assert_raises_rpc_error(-22, "TX decode failed Unsupported version number", self.nodes[0].decodepsbt, psbt.to_base64())
 
-    def test_psbt_missing_version_field(self):
         self.log.info("Test that a PSBT without the global version is interpreted as v0")
 
-        psbt = PSBT.from_base64(self.nodes[0].createpsbt([{"txid": "00" * 32, "vout": 0}], [{"data": "00"}]))
         del psbt.g.map[PSBT_GLOBAL_VERSION]
         assert_raises_rpc_error(-22, "TX decode failed No unsigned transaction was provided", self.nodes[0].decodepsbt, psbt.to_base64())
 
@@ -1836,8 +1834,7 @@ class PSBTTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         self.test_psbt_named_parameter_handling()
         self.test_psbt_roundtrip()
         self.test_psbt_version()
-        self.test_psbt_unsupported_version_field()
-        self.test_psbt_missing_version_field()
+        self.test_psbt_version_field()
         self.test_psbt_with_invalid_signature()
         self.test_musig2_untrusted_derivation()

```

After digging a little bit more into the test, I've noticed that regarding `PSBT_GLOBAL_VERSION` there is a case that is not coverd and we could add to this test:

```python
      psbt.g.map[PSBT_GLOBAL_VERSION] = (1).to_bytes(4, "little")
      assert_raises_rpc_error(-22, "TX decode failed There is no PSBT version 1", self.nodes[0].decodepsbt, psbt.to_base64())
```
This is the line where the error is thrown in `psbt.h`: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/9bf4815b94b9eaf8807f4e569091778da6c338d5/src/psbt.h#L1539

tACK eeb4782bda

Tested on macOS 27.0.1 (Apple Silicon arm64).

 rpc_psbt.py passes on the PR.
I reproduced both mutations suggested in the description. For each mutation, the PR's version of the test fails, while the version from master 6c01bd0b2d passes:

PSBT_HIGHEST_VERSION changed from 2 to 4:
  Expected: TX decode failed Unsupported version number
  Actual:   TX decode failed Unknown PSBT version

Removed the "No unsigned transaction was provided" throw:
  Expected: TX decode failed No unsigned transaction was provided
  Actual:   TX decode failed PSBT_GLOBAL_TX_VERSION is not allowed in PSBTv0
In both cases, a later check still rejects the PSBT. The new assertions catch the bypassed earlier check by verifying the specific error message.
Are you still working on this or can it be moved to draft while you reply to the review?
Addressed @Bicaru20 suggestions from https://github.com/nebula-21/bitcoin/pull/1 and added him as co-author

nit:  Since the test is for PSBTv2, I think it's better to explicity add the psbt version in case the default it is ever changed.

```suggestion
        psbt = PSBT.from_base64(self.nodes[0].createpsbt([{"txid": "00" * 32, "vout": 0}], [{"data": "00"}], psbt_version=2))
```
